COALESCE(inserted.qty_on_pick_tickets,0)         ELSE 0        END       ) AS sum_qty_on_release_schedule       ,inserted.source_loc_id       ,inserted.inv_mast_uid      FROM       inserted       INNER JOIN oe_hdr  WITH (NOLOCK) on oe_hdr.oe_hdr_uid=inserted.oe_hdr_uid       LEFT JOIN oe_line_service  WITH (NOLOCK) ON (oe_line_service.oe_line_uid = inserted.oe_line_uid)      WHERE       oe_hdr.rma_flag <> 'Y'       AND oe_line_service.oe_line_uid IS NULL       and inserted.detail_type <> 1       AND COALESCE(oe_hdr.order_type, 0) <> 1877        GROUP BY       inserted.source_loc_id       ,inserted.inv_mast_uid      UNION ALL      SELECT       SUM(          CASE         WHEN COALESCE(REPLACE(oe_hdr.projected_order, '', 'N'), 'N') <> 'Y'          AND deleted.detail_type <> 1          AND          (           COALESCE(deleted.qty_ordered,0)           - COALESCE(deleted.qty_canceled,0)           - COALESCE(deleted.qty_invoiced,0)           - COALESCE(deleted.qty_allocated,0)           --Scopus 791210 - Take into account qty_on_pick_tickets.           - INSERT INTO @holding   (   company_id ,   customer_id ,   date_ordered ,   extended_price ,   extended_cost   )  SELECT   company_id,   customer_id,   date_ordered,   sum(COALESCE(extended_price, 0)),   sum(COALESCE(extended_cost, 0))  FROM   (    SELECT     oe_hdr.company_id     ,oe_hdr.customer_id     ,CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR, oe_line.date_created, 106)) AS date_ordered     , SUM(      CASE       WHEN oe_hdr.rma_flag = 'Y'       THEN -1 * (COALESCE(ABS(oe_line.qty_ordered),0) - COALESCE(ABS(oe_line.qty_canceled),0))         * COALESCE(nullif(CAST(oe_line.unit_price/NULLIF(COALESCE(currency_line.exchange_rate,1),0) AS DECIMAL(19,9)), 0) / nullif(oe_line.pricing_unit_size,0), 0)       ELSE (COALESCE(ABS(oe_line.qty_ordered),0) - INSERT INTO @holding   (   company_id ,   customer_id ,   date_ordered ,   extended_price ,   extended_cost   )  SELECT   company_id,   customer_id,   date_ordered,   sum(COALESCE(extended_price, 0)),   sum(COALESCE(extended_cost, 0))  FROM   (    SELECT     oe_hdr.company_id     ,oe_hdr.customer_id     ,CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR, oe_line.date_created, 106)) AS date_ordered     , SUM(      CASE       WHEN oe_hdr.rma_flag = 'Y'       THEN -1 * (COALESCE(ABS(oe_line.qty_ordered),0) - COALESCE(ABS(oe_line.qty_canceled),0))         * COALESCE(nullif(CAST(oe_line.unit_price/NULLIF(COALESCE(currency_line.exchange_rate,1),0) AS DECIMAL(19,9)), 0) / nullif(oe_line.pricing_unit_size,0), 0)       ELSE (COALESCE(ABS(oe_line.qty_ordered),0) -
